messages:
Mia Chen: Pushed a vendor/lockfile bump to mia/vendor-lock-bump. Need to merge into release/v1.4 before cutoff (EOD PT). CI is failing on linux-asan and a couple integration flakes, pinging @Elena for submodule conflicts :eyes:

Elena Gomez: Looking now. I see submodule pointer changes for vendor/onnx — likely pointer drift rather than content issues. I'll try a local rebase/merge and open a PR if clean.

Raj Patel: If CI is flaky, can we re-run the failed job first? release-bot, can you rerun job 4521?

release-bot: Rerun scheduled: job 4521 queued by @Raj Patel. Status: queued.

Samir Khan: Quick compliance note — vendor bump touched third_party/zlib. Need license scan green before merging. Legal flagged that last time.

Mia Chen: Ack. I'll split the work into two commits to make review easier: 1) update submodule pointer, 2) regenerate lockfile. Hoping that isolates the CI/regression.

Elena Gomez: If helpful, I'll do the manual merge onto release/v1.4 and open a PR titled "prep: vendor pointer + lockfile (precutoff)". I'll add a small changelog snippet.

Mia Chen: Please do. Changelog should mention zlib bump and perf fixes under the 'deps' section. Keep wording terse.

Raj Patel: Reminder: cutoff is 2026-03-19 23:59 PT. Anything not merged by then goes through post-release patches. If CI is blocking, add a 'hold' label so we don't accidentally merge incomplete work.

Elena Gomez: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/1792 — contains two commits (pointer update + lockfile regen). Running local CI now. My local steps: ```
git checkout release/v1.4
git pull
git checkout -b elena/vendor-merge
git merge --no-ff mia/vendor-lock-bump
git push origin elena/vendor-merge
```

vendor-sync-bot: Vendor sync completed for PR #1792. Diff summary: zlib 1.2.12 -> 1.2.13, onnx pointer 0a1b2c -> 1d2e3f, lockfile updated (vendor/lock.json).

Samir Khan: License scan rerun is green. Compliance approves the zlib change. :+1:

Raj Patel: I pushed a tiny hotfix to release/v1.4 fixing linker flags for the new zlib. Will open a cherry-pick PR and re-run release branch CI once both PRs are merged.

Mia Chen: Thanks — can someone add the changelog entry and set milestone v1.4? @Theo can you plan to tag the release candidate once CI/approvals are all green? :shipit:

Theo: I'll tag rc-1 after green CI and approvals. Plan to do the tag around 18:00 PT if nothing else pops up. I'll watch the pipeline.

Mia Chen: One more ask — if linux-asan keeps flaking, let's consider marking it optional for this vendor-only merge to avoid blocking other release work.

Raj Patel: Agreed. I'm updating the merge gating to require 'integration' and 'smoke' to be green and mark 'asan' as optional for this PR. If we see regressions later we can revert.

Mia Chen: Great. Thanks everyone — I'll follow-up if anything else fails. :raised_hands:
